title: Figure 22. Impact-Range Distributions (Atlas IIAS)
description: Semi-log line graph of "Percent Impacts in 10-nm Interval" versus "Impact Range (nm)" (0 to 350), comparing theoretical results with simulated breakup q-alpha = 5,000 and 20,000 deg-lb/ft^2 and no-breakup cases. All curves decline from about 10% near the pad and then jump sharply at 350 nm. Text explains that the jump comes from lumping all impacts beyond 350 miles into one interval and notes good agreement out to 190 miles.
